what: For 01445 (fiber-boundary lint): pump.rs names `sched::fiber` (the `use crate::sched::{JobId, Wait, fiber}` and its `fiber::wait/claim/key_done/current_job` calls). sched now re-exports that free API from `crate::sched` (`sched::{wait, claim, key_done, miss, current_job, carry, Carried, NoWait}`): switch pump.rs to those, no behavior change. After one-pool lands its pump.rs deadlock fix; then sched makes `fiber` pub(crate).
